works.title: Cab Service
works.caption:
LamiRa EV Express – Chennai ↔ Trichy
Created a professional promotional social media creative for LamiRa EV Express, an eco-friendly EV taxi service connecting Chennai and Trichy. The design highlights the ₹3/km pricing, no extra charges, flexible boarding and drop-off options, and key service benefits such as safety, comfort, reliability, and eco-friendly travel.
The creative was designed to communicate the offer clearly, build trust, and encourage customers to book their ride. The project included visual design, marketing-focused messaging, offer presentation, and a strong call-to-action for customer enquiries and bookings.
